description: This file defines the interface IHeartbeatHandler for handling heartbeat ping/ack actions within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It declares pure virtual methods for sending a ping, reporting an error, and retrieving an identifier.

classes.name: IHeartbeatHandler
classes.description: An interface class that declares methods for handling heartbeat ping/ack actions, including sending a ping, error reporting, and retrieving an ID.

methods.name: pingSent
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle the event when a ping has been sent.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle error reporting related to heartbeat.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve the identifier associated with the heartbeat handler.
